pages.text: Altering Glass will result in Containment Glass - a special, hollowed out version of glass. It can hold liquid inside of it, including Water, Lava and Blood. It is also slightly sturdier than normal glass and can therefore be harvested without the need for Silk Touch.

Crystallized Bond Glass is similar to Containment Glass, with the exception that it's slightly less sturdy. This means that harvesting it without Silk Touch will result in it breaking and only returning a Crystallized Bond.
